recognize_zh: 血液抹片中央的中性球核只有兩葉、以粗短橋相連，染色質粗塊狀（類 Pelger 樣雙葉核）；背景紅血球大小不一並有卵圓形大紅血球，是 MDS 常見的血液抹片表現。
features: Neutrophil with a bilobed nucleus connected by a thick chromatin bridge (pseudo-Pelger-Huet change)
Cytoplasm with fine pink granules, only mildly reduced
Red cells show anisocytosis with macro-ovalocytes
Small platelet clump at lower edge
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows red cell anisocytosis with macro-ovalocytes. A neutrophil has a bilobed nucleus with coarsely clumped chromatin joined by a thick bridge, consistent with pseudo-Pelger-Huet change; cytoplasmic granulation is present but somewhat sparse. Platelets are present in small clumps and no blasts are seen. The findings are consistent with dysgranulopoiesis and macrocytosis, supporting a myelodysplastic neoplasm such as MDS with ring sideroblasts and multilineage dysplasia.

ddx.vs: Inherited anomaly shows uniform bilobed neutrophils in nearly all cells with normal granulation and normal counts.
Megaloblastic anemia features hypersegmented (≥6 lobes) neutrophils rather than hyposegmented forms.
Bands have a continuous horseshoe-shaped nucleus of uniform width and less condensed chromatin, not two discrete dense lobes.
